summary: The Backrooms: Level 0 is a multiplayer survival game in a seeded yellow maze, where players scavenge, fight smilers and lurkers, manage sanity and progress toward an exit. world.config.yaml wires the main maze, a separate debug room, player/camera, inputs and HUD; shared maze, tuning and loot code support both places. Player avatars are customizable procedural animal critters with mood-driven ears and tails, while first-person weapons are camera-posed locally.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0's nine-cell maze and safe hub; x0z0.scene holds hub props, maze and modeling-studio display; places/main/sim.js seeds stairs, shifts walls and replenishes pickups/enemies.

places/debug (3D) - isolated combat/test area with stations, enemy pens and release pads, now spread across the central cell and four adjoining cells; tagged almond-water test pickups use the uploaded studio bottle model; places/debug/sim.js maintains test items and release requests.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer world entry: main default place, player/camera templates, inputs, lighting, arrival handler, HUD and nametags.
templates/player.js - player body and behavior chain; humanoid-locomotion.js precedes player.js and critter.js; scripted avatar uses critter-geo.js with ear/tail jiggle and outline.
templates/camera.js and scripts/camera.js - custom look-oriented camera; camera script owns yaw/pitch and display-frame camera/viewmodel updates.
places/main/config.yaml and places/main/cells/* - 3D maze without terrain, partitioned into nine cells; x0z0 includes hub and modeling-studio display.
places/debug/config.yaml and places/debug/cells/* - separate 3D test room, stations, pens, labels, trigger pads and tagged test pickups across five cells.
places/main/sim.js and places/debug/sim.js - active place simulation cadence/ticks; root sim.js is empty.
shared: scripts/lib/maze.js - canonical seeded maze coordinate, zone, hub, wall, arch, pit, pillar and exit helpers; shared by level geometry, player, enemy AI and main-place spawning.
scripts/lib/data/level0.yml - maze dimensions and survival/combat/enemy/noise/figure/arch/stairs/wall-shift tuning consumed by gameplay, AI and place sims.
scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml - weapon stats, magazine/reload/ADS/muzzle/recoil settings, rarity and pickup tuning used by player, UI, loot, geometry and debug stations.
scripts/lib/data/critter.yml - avatar defaults and wardrobe choices for species, sex, outfit, accessories, face, colours, eyes and marks; read by critter.js and wardrobe-ui.js.

scripts/lib/loot.js, scripts/lib/debug-layout.js and scripts/lib/shapes.js - pickup/drop constructors, debug station coordinates and procedural mesh primitives reused across gameplay and geometry scripts.

anim/creatures.yml and clips/anim-creatures-yml-*.json - creature animation definitions and generated clips assigned by smiler/lurker AI; includes lurkerFrozen; mods/modeling-studio/ remains integrated through scripts/ui.js.

mods/custom-animations/ - creator-facing custom character animation skill and slash-command guides; describes generating/wiring model-only character animation behavior, separate from the game's current critter/enemy runtime.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js and places/debug/sim.js - export cadence, tick.
scripts/lib/maze.js - exports N, hash, inHub, zoneOf, cellCenter, cellAt, zoneAt, wallX, wallZ, isArchWall, hasPit, hasPillar.
scripts/player.js - exports maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, onInput, reloadMagIn, reloadDone, reloadStep, pumpRack, update; scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js each export update.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - exports sit, onInput, update; scripts/camera.js - exports finiteNumber, update; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - exports VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
scripts/critter.js - exports updateSchedule, blinkEnd, blinkNow, twitchEnd, onInput, update; scripts/critter-geo.js - exports geometry, skeleton, collider; scripts/wardrobe-ui.js - exports wardrobe.
scripts/level0-geo.js and creature geo scripts export geometry, skeleton, collider; scripts/weapon-geo.js and scripts/viewmodel-geo.js export geometry, collider.
scripts/lib/loot.js - exports spawnAlmond, spawnWeapon, spawnAmmo, spawnShells, rollWeapon, dropLoot; scripts/lib/debug-layout.js exports ROOM and test slot/pen constants.
scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js - default renderers; scripts/lighting.js exports lighting; scripts/arrival.js exports onArrive/onLeave; scripts/debug-pad.js exports onTriggerEnter.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state owns level/XP, HP, sanity, stamina, battery, almond count, visited-cell/zone tracking, kills/deaths, weapons/ammo, loaded magazines, equipped weapon and combat controls.

scripts/critter.js - player.state.look owns chosen avatar appearance; wardrobeOpen and face are player-state controls; mood/face reaction, blink/twitch, avatar key and preview scratch are session/local state.
scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - enemy state.hp/dead and AI mode/prey/gaze fields form the shared enemy row; path, animation mode and bite scratch is per-enemy session data.
places/main/sim.js - main place.state owns seed flags/refill times plus stairsSeeded and per-player shifted-wall timers; shifted walls and stairs are spawned entities.
places/debug/sim.js - debug place.state owns seeded/refill timing and want_smiler/want_lurker release requests set by debug pads.
scripts/camera.js - camera state owns yaw and pitch; camera session smooths ADS FOV, while scripts/lib/vmpose.js keeps local pose springs/timelines and animation scratch.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - body state holds shared turn/seat fields; gait smoothing and measured-pace scratch is in body session.

mods/modeling-studio/ - world.state.m3d owns shared studio model/edit/bug records; player state owns studio UI flags and player session owns local preview/manipulation scratch; scripts/ui.js renders without owning gameplay.
flows: world.config.yaml input axes/actions → templates/player.js → humanoid-locomotion.js runs first, then scripts/player.js handles movement/survival/weapons and scripts/critter.js handles avatar inputs/appearance.
world.config.yaml camera template → scripts/camera.js reads look orientation and writes camera yaw/pitch; player movement and smiler eye-contact checks use aim/camera direction.
wardrobe (C), emote (T), dress action → scripts/critter.js onInput → player.state.wardrobeOpen/look/face; scripts/wardrobe-ui.js renders choices and sends dress actions through scripts/ui.js.

scripts/critter.js reads player.state look and mood → scripts/critter-geo.js builds the replicated avatar; mood clips drive Tail/Tail1 and EarL/EarR, while blink/twitch apply bone overrides; local wardrobe preview rotates and shares the outline styling.
world.config.yaml aim/reload inputs → scripts/player.js onInput → player.state ADS/reload and loaded/reserve fields; scripts/ui.js renders magazine counts or reload status.
scripts/player.js writes player.state survival/progression/weapons/ammo → scripts/ui.js and mods/modeling-studio/hud.js render HUD; humAt drives transient HUM SPIKE warning.
scripts/player.js ranged attack reads loaded magazine and ADS cone → tagged smiler/lurker state.hp/dead; enemy updates reward/remove dead enemies and damage or sap sanity from players.
scripts/player.js reload callbacks mutate rounds and reloadN; token/equipped checks reject stale callbacks, while shotgun reloads shell-by-shell and may fire mid-reload.
scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js target ctx.place.players and write prey player.state HP/sanity → scripts/ui.js; damage effects are audience-targeted to the affected player.

scripts/smilers.js assigns smilerIdle/smilerHunt and smilerBite clips; scripts/lurkers.js selects lurkerIdle/lurkerWalk/lurkerFrozen from AI mode; creature geometry skeletons supply the animated bones.

scripts/player.js spawns local camera-attached viewmodel and publishes vmId/swing/reload/equip/pump/dry-fire markers → scripts/camera.js calls scripts/lib/vmpose.js each display frame, using weapons.yml for cosmetic motion.
Place sims query tagged pickups/enemies and use level0.yml, weapons.yml, loot.js and maze.js to seed/refill; debug pads set place.state release requests; arrival handlers connect the places.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* authored lights - repeated warm fluorescent fixtures across nine cells, with red-zone variants aligned to the maze layout.

scripts/almond-geo.js, scripts/figure-geo.js, scripts/smiler-geo.js, scripts/lurker-geo.js, scripts/stairs-geo.js, scripts/weapon-geo.js, scripts/viewmodel-geo.js and scripts/critter-geo.js - procedural geometry reuses shared shape helpers.
templates/player.js behavior chain - humanoid-locomotion.js precedes player.js and critter.js; gait reads prior body movement before player control writes velocity.

scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - parallel enemy update loops share player targeting, maze path/line checks, bite/death/effect patterns, with smiler light attraction/stare slowdown and lurker gaze-freeze/sanity behavior.

scripts/camera.js + scripts/lib/vmpose.js - display-frame camera/viewmodel motion; weapons.yml varies firearm recoil, reload and sight/muzzle positions, while pose effects remain local cosmetic animation.
scripts/lib/data/sounds.yml - named player action sounds map to one or more CDN takes; scripts/player.js rotates variants and falls back for unmapped names.
scripts/critter-geo.js - one procedural rig varies by species, sex, outfit, expression, eye shape and marks; critter.js layers mood-driven ear/tail clips and wardrobe preview on that rig.
places/debug/cells/* tagged almond pickups - repeated test props across the debug cells use the shared uploaded studio bottle model while retaining almond tags.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - no active place uses it; both places explicitly have terrain off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/reed.js - no active terrain layers or placed references; main/debug terrain is off.
migrationNotes: scripts/lib/maze.js and scripts/lib/data/level0.yml are a coupled layout/gameplay contract: keep geometry, zones, spawning, and AI rules aligned; maze uses 36 cells at 4 metres each, around HALF, with 3m walls.
The safe hub spans indices 16–19 on both axes; mesh doorway, zone logic and enemy restrictions depend on this shared definition; the exit is maze cell (0,33).
The player template order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js and critter.js; reversing it changes which velocity locomotion reads.

Player progression/inventory, ADS/reload state and critter look/wardrobe state live in player.state; local control, face reaction, preview and viewmodel animation/token scratch live in session. Ammo and shells are reserves; loaded_<weapon> is magazine state.
critter-geo.js rig bone names Tail, Tail1, EarL and EarR are shared by jiggle, mood flair and creature clips; preserve bone names and avoid overlapping animation tracks when changing the avatar rig.

weapons.yml order/keys, ammoType, magSize, ADS offsets and recoil units are contracts across cycling, reload callbacks, pickups/drops, debug slots, UI, weapon geometry and vmpose; muzzle offsets use camera-attached viewmodel space.
